central_unknown: F1 hasn't raced at Sepang since 2017, so no modern-era data exists for these cars. Rain is forecast throughout the weekend, which could dramatically alter the competitive order and make practice sessions critical for lineup decisions.

budget_tiers.core: Antonelli (captain), Mercedes constructor, one of Ferrari/McLaren constructor

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: Kimi Antonelli
captains.reason: ML projects 24.7 exp pts (highest of all drivers), 30.2 proj pts, ppm 1.93, LOW risk, DNF prob only 0.04. Channels unanimously back Antonelli as the premium captain pick. Mercedes dominated recent practice sessions and their power unit suits Sepang's sector 3. Best risk-adjusted ceiling on the grid.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Max Verstappen
captains.reason: ML projects 23.5 exp pts (3rd overall), pred quali P7 → finish P2 suggesting massive overtake points potential, ppm 1.43, MEDIUM risk. FanAmp notes Red Bull Ford power unit is strong and team is trending upward. Higher variance play (90% CI -14.0 to 51.0) but enormous ceiling if Red Bull's engine advantage materializes in sector 3.

buy.name: Isack Hadjar
buy.note: ML projects 10.3 exp pts at only 15.1M — fantastic ppm of 1.72. Needs very few points for price rise (channels cite -2 pts threshold). Racing Bulls constructor also strong value at 15.3M with 22.2 exp pts. Key budget-building asset.

buy.name: Franco Colapinto
buy.note: Averaging 11.1 pts/race, outperforming teammate Gasly recently. Needs only -8 pts for price rise per BoxBox analysis. Longest active non-DNF streak. Excellent budget builder at rock-bottom price.

buy.name: Arvid Lindblad
buy.note: Floor-price asset, needs -5 pts for price rise. BoxBox identifies him as a no-brainer budget builder. Minimal downside risk at price floor.

consider.name: Liam Lawson
consider.price: ~15.1M (or ~9.7M if moved back to Racing Bulls)
consider.note: Scored 12, 2, 16 pts over last 3 races at Red Bull. Seat situation uncertain — if Hadjar returns from injury, Lawson may shift teams. Monitor team announcements before deadline. Needs -3 pts for price rise. Channels flag him as strong value if seat situation resolves favorably.

consider.name: Alex Albon
consider.note: Williams bringing update package. Historical Baku form strong (12-13 pts). Mr. Consistent at 2.1 pts/race average. Cheap option if budget constrained. BoxBox swapped Alonso for Albon in Italian GP lineup citing higher scoring potential.

consider.name: George Russell
consider.note: ML projects 23.6 exp pts (2nd highest), pred quali P1 → finish P1. However, 0.15 DNF risk and highest price on grid reduce value (ppm 1.25). If not captaining Antonelli, Russell is the premium Mercedes alternative. Channels note Mercedes power unit strong for sector 3.

avoid: Aston Martin assets — both channels and BoxBox agree their performance has been poor; Alonso and Stroll not competitive
Cadillac assets — bottom of the barrel, killing ranks per F1FantasyPolePosition
Sergio Perez — BoxBox explicitly says stay away
Valtteri Bottas — at price floor but reliability is terrible (recent scores of -20, -18)
Oscar Piastri — ML projects only 15.2 exp pts at 24.0M (ppm 0.61), MEDIUM risk; channels note tough season mentally, not in championship fight; better value exists elsewhere

chips.name: 3x Boost
chips.reason: BoxBox activated 3x on Antonelli at Monza when Mercedes dominated practice, and it outscored Limitless in simulations. If Mercedes shows similar dominance at Sepang in FP sessions, 3x on Antonelli could be the play — ML gives him LOW risk and highest expected points. However, rain uncertainty at a new circuit adds variance. Wait for FP3 data before committing.

chips.name: Wildcard
chips.reason: Multiple channels emphasize budget building heading into the final stretch. If you haven't used Wildcard yet, the triple-header window coming up may be more optimal. Use free transfers to pivot to budget builders this week.

chips.name: Limitless
chips.reason: BoxBox showed Limitless scored lower than 3x Boost in Italian GP simulations. At an unfamiliar rain-threatened circuit, the variance makes Limitless risky. Save for a more predictable weekend with clearer form lines.

chips.name: 4A (Four A-Tier)
chips.reason: BoxBox and channels suggest building toward 4A activation at upcoming races where Ferrari + McLaren or similar dual-A constructor lineups are more clearly favored. This weekend's unknowns make it suboptimal.

watch_items: Rain forecast for all sessions — wet conditions at Sepang could reshuffle the entire competitive order; monitor weather updates hourly before deadline
FP1-FP3 running order is critical — F1 hasn't raced here since 2017, so practice pace is the only reliable data; Chris McCarthy notes confident drivers adapt to new circuits fastest

McLaren's shorter gearbox ratio — FanAmp/Ruth Buskcom analysis shows Sepang has one of the highest low-speed acceleration ratios of the season, potentially a major McLaren advantage, but rain could negate this
Mercedes power unit advantage in sector 3 — FanAmp's Terry flags this as a key differentiator; ML data confirms Mercedes as top constructor by a wide margin (64.2 exp pts vs Ferrari 48.7)
Isack Hadjar injury status — if he returns to Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson's seat situation changes dramatically; monitor team announcements
Williams update package — could boost Albon's scoring potential; watch FP performance
Ferrari engine concerns — FanAmp questions whether Ferrari can challenge due to sector 3 power deficit; ML ranks Ferrari 2nd in constructor expected points but well behind Mercedes
arc: This Bahrain GP at Sepang is the first of three consecutive races where McLaren's shorter gearbox ratio provides a theoretical advantage (per Ruth Buskcom's analysis). Budget building is paramount heading into the final stretch — channels unanimously stress getting Hadjar, Lawson, Colapinto, and Lindblad locked in for guaranteed price rises. The rain wildcard at a circuit no current driver has raced in modern F1 machinery makes this weekend inherently unpredictable, so conservative chip usage is wise. The data gathered here will be invaluable for recalibrating expectations for the remaining races, and if Mercedes truly dominates as ML projects, locking in their assets through the season's end becomes the clear meta. Watch for 4A opportunities at the next round if budget building goes well this week.
